label: ASC AI v1 — Clear/Cloudy + Rain (PyTorch ResNet18)
summary: Next-gen ASC: one ResNet18 dual-head (sky ∈ {clear, cloudy}, rain ∈ {true, false}). More MFT data, tighter labels, stronger training than the Teachable Machine four-model stack. Ready cloud gate: sky == clear. Trained on 2135 MFT frames; frozen Test n=178 (sky ~93.8%, gate ~92.1%).
notes: Removes Teachable Machine Day/Night Cloud+Rain models and ASC AI v0.6 from the repo. Frozen Test metrics in ASC_AI_v1/MANIFEST.json.
